Our All-Inclusive Hitting Development System

We Tested Two Models. One Wasn’t Close.

We’ve replaced one-off lessons with a true player development system that we have tested and proven over and over again with hitters of all ages.

Retired September 1st

Pay-Per-Lesson

The model most hitters have experienced — with us and everywhere else.

  • A one-off lesson once per week, every two weeks, or once a month
  • One hour of coaching, then a week on your own with no plan
  • Slower adjustments, less retention, smaller jumps on the field
  • Nothing included but an hour of your time in a cage
  • Nothing to do in between lessons but wait — no plan, no system
  • No refunds, no guarantees — the risk is all on you
The only way we train now

Full Stack Hitting Development

A monthly membership where you train with us every single day — not one hour per week.

  • In-person training at our facility
  • Remote coaching from Austin and the G1 staff every day
  • Every plan includes strength, conditioning & nutrition programming, updated each month
  • Full access to our complete video course library, covering every part of your plan
  • Faster development, quicker adjustments, better retention, and the biggest jumps in on-field success we’ve ever seen
  • 90‑day money‑back guarantee

We’ve tested both of these models and the performance gap between the two models was undeniable. Athletes using our full stack hitting system consistently demonstrated greater progress, better retention, and more meaningful long-term adaptation than those training through individual lessons. The difference was significant enough that we made the decision to move away from the pay-per-lesson model entirely.

Who we are

A Higher Tier of Training

G1 was built for the baseball and softball player seeking a higher standard of hitting development. Hitting is one of the most demanding skills in all of sports. We believe the environment, coaching, and development process surrounding it should reflect that level of difficulty. Our mission is to provide serious athletes with access to elite-level coaching, technology, equipment, and a training environment built specifically for long-term development. We work with athletes who understand that reaching the next level requires more than occasional instruction — it requires a commitment to a structured and intentional development process.

At G1, we take a comprehensive approach to building hitters. Every athlete trains within a system that connects skill development, movement quality, physical preparation, objective data, and individualized programming under one roof. We’ve spent years refining our development systems to make them actionable, measurable, and repeatable — giving athletes a clear path forward rather than a collection of disconnected lessons and drills.

Meet the founder

Austin Guy

Founder · Hitting Coach

Austin has spent the last ten years traveling the United States learning from top hitting coaches, and is dedicated to helping players become confident, dangerous hitters.

  • Head Baseball Coach, Leonardtown High School in Southern Maryland — career record 46‑18 (.741)
  • 2024 4A Maryland State Champion — the school’s second title ever, and first since 1987
  • Hitting coach, Shepherd University (D2) 2017–2019
  • Shepherd’s offense ranked top 10 in the country in batting average, home runs, on-base percentage, slugging, and runs per game

How it works

From Application to Everyday Development

Here’s how the process works.

1

Submit Your Application

Complete our athlete application so we can learn more about your goals, training history, and current needs. Even if you’ve previously trained with G1 or submitted a form in the past, please complete the new application. It only takes 1-2 minutes to complete.

2

Speak With Our Team

Within 48 business hours, a member of the G1 team will contact you to discuss the program, learn more about the athlete, answer your questions, and determine whether the program is the right fit.

3

Secure Your Membership

If accepted, you’ll have the opportunity to secure one of our limited development memberships. Once your membership is confirmed, we’ll begin the onboarding process and prepare you for your September 1st start.

4

Begin Your Development

Your training goes far beyond your scheduled in-person sessions. You’ll enter a structured development system combining weekly in-person coaching, individualized programming, and remote support throughout the month — giving you a clear roadmap for what to train, why you’re training it, and how to continue progressing.

What’s included

Everything You Get as a Member

One monthly membership. The full stack — every tool, every touchpoint, every day.

In-Person Training

Train with us in-person at our facility either once or multiple times per week.

Daily Remote Coaching

24/7 Coaching from Austin and the G1 staff every day, including weekly practice plans and drill sets with step-by-step video included.

Strength & Conditioning Program

A full customized strength and conditioning program that is guaranteed to help you hit the ball with more authority.

Full Video Swing Course

Each hitter gets access to a full step-by-step video curriculum that explains every aspect of the swing and every drill in great detail. Accessible anywhere through our remote training platform.

Online Hitting Community

Access to our online community with all of the hitters that we train, where we discuss all things hitting and learn from each other’s experiences.

Video Analysis & Feedback

Swing feedback on your game swings, practice swings, and anything else that you would like your coaches to review.

Progress Tracking & Accountability

We track your development at every step and hold you accountable to it — camera angles, HitTrax reports, and our own proprietary progress reports.

A Clear Daily Roadmap

You’ll never have to guess what to work on — a clear roadmap tells you exactly what to do every single day.

Frequently Asked Questions

Before You Start

Can I still book a single lesson?
No. To be very transparent, as of September 1st we no longer offer pay-per-lesson. We tested both models side by side for a year, and the development program produced results that weren’t close — so the monthly development program is now the only way athletes train with us.
How many spots are available?
Development memberships are limited. Current clients, past clients, and everyone on our waitlist get priority access before the program is released to the public, and we anticipate spots will go very fast.
How often will I actually train?
Every day. You’ll train in-person with us at our facility, and get remote coaching from the G1 staff every day — including strength & conditioning, weekly practice plans, drill sets with step-by-step video, and a clear roadmap for what to work on each day.
How does the 90-day money-back guarantee work?
Simply put: if you or your child are not happy with your swing after 90 days, we refund you in full. You either love your swing after 90 days, or you don’t pay. Terms apply.
Do you train softball players?
Yes — G1 was founded for the baseball/softball player that is looking for a higher tier of training for their hitting development. The program is built for both.
I filled out a form with you before. Do I need to apply again?
Yes — please fill out the new application form even if you have filled out a previous form with us. It’s how we’re assigning memberships.
How fast will I hear back after I apply?
We will contact you within 48 business hours. Have questions in the meantime? Call or text us or email Info@g1-baseball.com.
I’m a parent filling this out for my athlete. Is that okay?
Absolutely. Fill out the application on your athlete’s behalf and we’ll follow up with you directly.
